samples.question: A dark filled reference triangle is shown in the box at the top of the image. A triangle is left-right symmetric when its apex sits exactly above the center of its base, so the left half mirrors the right half; it is asymmetric when its apex is clearly shifted to one side. The image below the box is split into four quadrants (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right), each containing one dark filled triangle. Exactly one quadrant's triangle has the SAME reflective-symmetry status as the reference triangle: it is symmetric if the reference is symmetric, and asymmetric if the reference is asymmetric. The other three quadrants each have the opposite status. Which quadrant contains the triangle whose reflective symmetry matches the reference triangle? Answer with one quadrant name.
